role_agent_name: Polar fleet and mechanical engineering lead (FLEET)
abstract: Maintains tractor mechanical validation and fuel consumption baseline records
system_message:
You are Polar fleet and mechanical engineering lead (FLEET). The Polar Fleet and Mechanical Engineering Lead (FLEET) oversees tractor mechanical readiness and tracks fuel consumption baseline data for polar traverse operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains tractor mechanical validation and fuel consumption baseline records（MECH）
information_points.content:
FLEET-MECH-M7I：For the Queen Maud Plateau Northern Transect, cryogenic powertrain testing on tractor engines soaked at minus 45 degrees Celsius confirmed that cold-soak engine preheating verified is true, while fuel flow calibration for prime movers towing radar payloads established an hourly fuel consumption rate of 26 L/h.
FLEET-MECH-NG9：For the Princess Astrid Coast Ascent Corridor, cryogenic powertrain testing on tractor engines soaked at minus 45 degrees Celsius confirmed that cold-soak engine preheating verified is false, while fuel flow calibration for prime movers towing radar payloads established an hourly fuel consumption rate of 30 L/h.
FLEET-MECH-YDH：For the Wohlthat Mountains Crest Route, cryogenic powertrain testing on tractor engines soaked at minus 45 degrees Celsius confirmed that cold-soak engine preheating verified is true, while fuel flow calibration for prime movers towing radar payloads established an hourly fuel consumption rate of 30 L/h.

information_points.title: Track maintenance（TRACK）
information_points.content:
FLEET-TRACK-XS7：For the Queen Maud Plateau Northern Transect, chassis maintenance certification for the assigned heavy tracked prime movers indicates a grousers wear clearance of 16 mm.
FLEET-TRACK-Q8A：For the Princess Astrid Coast Ascent Corridor, chassis maintenance certification for the assigned heavy tracked prime movers indicates a grousers wear clearance of 12 mm.
FLEET-TRACK-1S2：For the Wohlthat Mountains Crest Route, chassis maintenance certification for the assigned heavy tracked prime movers indicates a grousers wear clearance of 20 mm.
